typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SYS_ID as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		GRANT_DT as timestamp,
		EMP_ID as long,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USERNAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as timestamp,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    SYS_ID  , DATABASENAME  , USERNAME , USER_FULL_NAME , USER_EMAIL_ADDR , USER_ROLE_LIST , EMP_ID , LAST_ACCESS_DT , GRANT_DT , RPT_DT from  TDINFINFO.V_PR00045_ENTPS_SNDBX_LAST_ACCESS_INFO_HIST qualify RPT_DT >= add_months(max(RPT_DT) over (), -3)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ADONETSource
ADONETSource sink(input(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		GRANT_DT as string,
		USER_EMP_ID as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USERNAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ENVRN_TXT = SYS_ID,
		USER_FULL_NAME,
		USER_ROLE_LIST,
		GRANT_DT,
		USER_EMP_ID = EMP_ID,
		RPT_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		USERNAME,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
